name: StickyCTABar
description: The sticky bottom bar on smaller screens: the current total and the primary action of the booking step.

provenance.tag: A · unverified (sticky bottom action bar on mobile); states: Rec

props.name: quoteStatus
props.description: Drives the updating, quote-error and price-changed states.

props.name: missing
props.description: From canContinue(step). When set, the button stays enabled and pressing it leads the user to the missing item.

states.name: ready
states.visual: Primary Button enabled; total from a fresh quote.

states.name: incomplete
states.visual: Button stays enabled, with a hint in caption ("Select seats for 1 more passenger"). Pressing it scrolls to and focuses the first missing item and announces what's missing. A disabled button would hide the reason.

states.name: updating
states.visual: The previous total stays visible with a skeleton in --color-bg-muted; the button shows loading.

states.name: quote-error
states.visual: Inline error with a Retry button; the primary button is disabled until a quote succeeds.

states.name: price-changed
states.visual: The new total is shown next to the struck-through old total; continuing opens a confirm dialog.

requirements: It must not cover the focused element: use scroll-padding-bottom equal to its height.
When the step is incomplete, the button stays enabled; pressing it moves focus to the first missing item and announces what's missing.

source.tag: A · unverified (mobile); moved to below lg per D21
